theme: The illustration style combines gradient shading and clean linework to depict a vibrant fairy-tale setting. The color palette is rich and vivid, capturing the mythical ambiance of trolls, castles, and enchanted swans. Characters are portrayed with stylized proportions to emphasize their fantastical nature, and the use of dramatic lighting adds to the magical atmosphere. The textures are smooth, enhancing the whimsical and otherworldly feel of the storybook world, with an underlying charm that reflects the adventurous and mischievous tone of the classic folktale.
